stem: What can the reader conclude from Michael Vecchione’s comments throughout the selection “A Ghostly New Creature”?

options.label: A
options.text: Vecchione is not interested in learning more about the new octopod.

options.label: B
options.text: Vecchione is fascinated by the discovery of new species.

options.label: C
options.text: Vecchione was the coordinator of the project that discovered the unknown creature.

options.label: D
options.text: Vecchione was first to understand the significance of finding the new octopod.
